layer_1_upper_soft_tpu_85a.structural_purpose: Flexible protective upper foot airframe. Sliced in soft 85A TPU with a 3-wall loop shell to conform to foot variables, ensuring the continuous lengthwise male rails print completely supportless and smooth.

layer_2_sole_dense_tpu_95a.structural_purpose: Variable-density elephant-pad structural sole midsole. Sliced in high-durability 95A TPU. Perimeters bumped to 5 wall loops specifically around the internal Debris Evacuation Relief Wells to seal the cored subsurface gyroid cavity watertight, while printing the Overlocking Crocodile Hood Pocket supportless.

layer_3_insole_velvet_tpu_80a.structural_purpose: Removable zero-friction internal comfort insert liner. Sliced at an ultra-fine 0.12mm track out of highly elastic 80A TPU to provide a completely smooth, velvet-matte plane that eliminates heat spots.
